correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication gives [x,y]=(0,(a-c)w-(d-f)v,0). This equation yields the center, the single centralizer H for delta=0,v nonzero, and q^r distinct q^2 centralizers C_u for delta nonzero, hence q^r+2 in total. For a prescribed radical commutator z, counting coefficient pairs (delta,epsilon) gives q^(2r)+(q^2-1)q^r reduced zero solutions and (q^2-1)q^r reduced solutions for each z nonzero; each has q^2 lifts to algebra elements. Dividing the zero fiber by |A|^2 gives the stated probability. In the divisor family q^r=p^M is fixed and the probability is strictly decreasing in the field exponent a, so the collision claim follows.
